title: The Dung Heap Court
text: The Faceless City's beggars have a lord. He holds court on a dung heap, crowned with a chamber pot, his courtiers in rags bowing in the stink. Nobody notices beggars, so beggars notice everything. He knows every secret in the city, and he sells them.

options.label: Pay the beggar lord for a secret.

outcomes.text: A rival House's weakness, whispered through rotten teeth.

options.label: The kindest shares their food with his court.

outcomes.text: He names them a friend of the poor, and every beggar in the city will know their face.

options.label: Threaten him on his own heap.

outcomes.text: Every beggar in the city turns, and there are a great many beggars.
